ei.title: 기술적 실업이 사회 질서에 미치는 위험

fullPassage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and a source of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.

det.analysis: The 뒤에 명사 필요. equal(동등한) → equality(평등) → inequality(불평등). 격차가 커지고 있으므로 부정 명사.

questions.passage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, __________. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기술적 실업이 경제와 삶의 의미 모두를 위협하는 이유
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 기술적 실업이 소득과 삶의 의미 모두를 위협하는 이유: 경제적 불평등 + 성취감/목적 상실.
❌ ① 기술 발전이 생산성을 높이는 방법: 본문은 긍정적 측면을 다루지 않음.
❌ ② 불평등을 해소하기 위한 정부 정책: 해결책을 제시하지 않음.
❌ ③ 직업에서 성취감을 높이는 전략: 성취감의 상실 위협이 주제.
det.tip: 핵심: 기술적 실업 → 경제적 불평등 + 의미 상실

questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기술적 실업의 위험: 경제와 의미의 이중 위기
det.analysis:
✅ ① The Threat of Technological Unemployment: 기술적 실업이 경제와 의미 양쪽을 위협.
❌ ② How Technology Creates New Jobs: 일자리 창출이 아닌 실업의 위협.
❌ ③ The Benefits of Economic Growth: 경제 성장의 혜택이 아닌 위험.
❌ ④ Finding Purpose Through Work: 목적 발견이 아닌 상실의 위협.
det.tip: 제목 = 글 전체의 핵심 주제 요약
